RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions.getSourc.en:
Override the URL written into each rewritten sourceMappingURL. Defaults
to `${debugMetadataUrl}?field=source-map&path=<encoded mapPath>`.
RewriteSourceMappingURLsOptions.getSourc.text: 覆盖写入每个被重写的 sourceMappingURL 的 URL。默认为 `${debugMetadataUrl}?field=source-map&path=<encoded mapPath>`。

DEBUG_METADATA_ASSET_NAME.summary.en: Default name of the debug metadata asset emitted alongside each template.
DEBUG_METADATA_ASSET_NAME.summary.text: 与每个模板一同输出的调试元数据产物的默认名称。

pluginLynxDebugMetadata.summary.en:
Register `debug-metadata.json` emission for Lynx template builds (`lynx`
and `lynx-*` environments; skipped in local production builds and removed
from non-development output unless `DEBUG` is set) and serve sub-field
queries via a connect-style dev-server middleware.

Registered by `pluginLynx` from `@lynx-js/rsbuild-plugin`.

The dev-server middleware exposes these endpoints (relative to each
entry's intermediate dir):

```text
GET .../debug-metadata.json
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&path=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&key=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=bytecode-debug-info&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifact&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifacts
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=ui-source-map
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=buildInfo
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=git
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=rspeedy

GET .../*.js.map    → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
GET .../*.css.map   → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
```
pluginLynxDebugMetadata.summary.text:
为 Lynx 模板构建（`lynx`
和 `lynx-*` environment；在本地生产构建中会跳过，且除非设置了 `DEBUG`，否则会从非开发环境的产物中移除）注册 `debug-metadata.json` 的输出，并通过 connect 风格的开发服务器中间件提供子字段查询。

由 `@lynx-js/rsbuild-plugin` 中的 `pluginLynx` 注册。

开发服务器中间件暴露以下端点（相对于每个入口的中间目录）：

```text
GET .../debug-metadata.json
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&path=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=source-map&key=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=bytecode-debug-info&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifact&filename=…
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=artifacts
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=ui-source-map
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=buildInfo
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=git
GET .../debug-metadata.json?field=rspeedy

GET .../*.js.map    → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
GET .../*.css.map   → transparently forwarded to ?field=source-map
```

rewriteSourceMappingURLs.summary.en:
Rewrite the `//# sourceMappingURL=...` directive of every JS asset in the
current template to an absolute URL. No-op when `debugMetadataUrl`
(`args.encodeData.sourceContent.config['debugMetadataUrl']`) is unset.
rewriteSourceMappingURLs.summary.text:
将当前模板中每个 JS 产物的 `//# sourceMappingURL=...` 指令重写为绝对 URL。当 `debugMetadataUrl`
（`args.encodeData.sourceContent.config['debugMetadataUrl']`）未设置时不做任何处理。
